  • Class
    Description
    AimBelief
    Where the enemy aims: a belief over guess factors, the chance that a wave's bullet lies on a given stretch of bearings (JET-2's "aim belief").
    Arcs
    Bearing arithmetic for hit sets and shadows.
    Gait
    Sepia's movement: one fixed landing per enemy shot, chosen for how little of it the enemy's aim and our ink leave exposed.
    Gait.Forecast
    One option played forward: the states tick by tick and the landing it gives a wave.
    Gait.Kind
    Which gait: the jet cycle, or the ink surf.
    Gait.Option
    One choice for a wave's stretch of path: which way round the source, and how fast.
    Gait.Rater
    How the caller rates a landing: its exposure, the lower the better.
    Gait.Segment
    A stretch of committed path: an option, round a centre, until a tick.
    InkPlanner
    The ink planner (INK-1 to INK-5): where to aim a 0.1 bullet so that it stops the most danger over the landings Sepia has fixed.
    InkPlanner.Shot
    One planned shot: its aim, and what it adds over the waves it was scored on.
    InkWave
    One enemy shot, read from its energy drop, with the landing Sepia has fixed for it.
    InkWave.Landing
    A copy of the landing and its shadows, so a trial landing can be put back.
    PunchGun
    The punch: a plain segmented guess-factor gun, Sepia's stand-in until the design promotes Hadur's gun to the kernel (its stage H2).
    SepiaBrain
    Sepia's brain for one battle: reads the enemy's shots, fixes a landing for each with the Gait, lays ink across those landings with the InkPlanner, and punches with the PunchGun when a punch is worth more (STRIKE-1).
    SepiaBrain.Fire
    What the gun may do: the lab arms of the design's first card.
    SepiaBrain.Orders
    The orders for one tick, as the adapter applies them.
